facts.fact: The digital transition ministry inaugurated two modular public-administration datacenters in Ouagadougou on 23 January 2026, built to hold the state's civil registry, health, tax and civil service data and platforms; 3,000 TB storage, cost over 15bn FCFA.

The minister and Prime Minister said government platforms and data are still hosted abroad or in private centres and ordered their repatriation (aim: zero public administration data outside the country).
facts.system: Government data hosted abroad or in private centres
